nico: opened PR 1102 — migration guide: Dedicated -> Private (VPC) with HSM rekeying notes and minimal runbook. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 :spiral_notepad:
sasha: thanks. please add an explicit step for exporting the existing key metadata (label, key-id, algo) and a sample CSR flow when customers must generate a new HSM key remotely. we've seen confusion on this during migrations.
miles: also include a short operator checklist: preflight network ACLs, control-plane endpoints whitelist, and required firewall ports. tiny snippet for iptables/nftables would be handy.
grace: we should add a Node.js SDK example that demonstrates acquiring a short-lived cert from the private control plane and falling back to disk-stored client cert if network fails. ops asked for it.
nico: plan: add sections: 1) export-key metadata example 2) CSR + enroll curl example 3) nftables snippet for VPC egress 4) systemd unit to mount HSM socket 5) nodejs SDK fallback snippet 6) migration troubleshooting bullets
sasha: for the CSR flow, include the api contract and an example response shape (job id + status). use placeholder urls and avoid secrets.
miles: nftables minimal rules suggestion:
```bash
# allow redwood control plane and KMS subnets
sudo nft add table inet redwood
sudo nft 'add chain inet redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop; }'
sudo nft add rule inet redwood forward ip daddr 10.200.0.0/24 tcp dport 443 accept
sudo nft add rule inet redwood forward udp dport 53 accept
```
grace: nodejs snippet (keep it short):
```js
// try control plane for cert, fallback to local cert file
const fs = require('fs')
const https = require('https')
function fetchCert(url) {
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    https.get(url + '/client-cert', {timeout:2000}, r => {
      let b=''
      r.on('data', c => b+=c)
      r.on('end', () => res(b))
    }).on('error', rej)
  })
}
async function getCert() {
  try { return await fetchCert('https://private-control.example') }
  catch (e) { return fs.readFileSync('/var/lib/redwood/client-cert.pem','utf8') }
}
getCert().then(c => console.log(c.slice(0,80)))
```
sasha: add a note to rotate client-cert permissions to 0600 and mention that cached certs have limited TTL; advise an offline re-enroll process for >TTL sites.
nico: systemd unit to bind HSM socket so the installer sees /var/run/hsm.sock:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Bind HSM socket for installer
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/mkdir -p /var/run/hsm && /bin/socat UNIX-LISTEN:/var/run/hsm.sock,fork TCP:127.0.0.1:12345 &
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
miles: troubleshooting bullets: - "enroll job stuck" -> check outbound TLS, system clock, and control-plane whitelist. - "HSM key not found" -> verify PKCS11 label, permissions, and SELinux contexts. - "installer fails on cert pin" -> ensure the pinned fingerprint matches /etc/redwood/trusted-keys.
sasha: wording nit: use "private control plane" consistently and spell out the TTL (default 24h) when referencing cached certs.

grace: I'll run the smoke test this afternoon and report back. if all good we can merge after CI + one manual run. :rocket:
